title: The Session Manager Field Manual
summary: A warm, plain-English guide to AI agents — and to running your own small agency of them with Claude Code and Session Manager. No experience needed.

chapters.title: Welcome — your friendly map of what's ahead
chapters.blurb: Who this manual is for, what Claude Code and Session Manager are, and how to get the most from the pages ahead. No experience needed.

chapters.title: What is an AI agent?
chapters.blurb: The difference between a chatbot that answers and an agent that gets things done — and the four parts every agent is made of.

chapters.title: Claude Code in plain English
chapters.blurb: The building blocks of Claude Code — sessions, house rules, skills, tools and permissions — explained without the jargon.

chapters.title: Meet your agency — the team that works for you
chapters.blurb: Session Manager gives you a small team of AI agents: a planner, builders and a checker. Here's who does what, and why a team beats a single assistant.

chapters.title: Your first Session — from idea to working agent
chapters.blurb: Install the free app, open a project, and hand your agency its first job in about ten minutes.

chapters.title: Work that runs while you're away — plans and the Scheduler
chapters.blurb: How a big idea becomes small work orders, and how the Scheduler runs them in the background around your usage limits.

chapters.title: Trust, but verify — how the work gets checked
chapters.blurb: Checklists, tests and a dedicated checker agent — plus what to do when a job stops to ask you a question.

chapters.title: Shaping your team — Agents, Missions and one-click Actions
chapters.blurb: Write your own agents in plain English, pick the right kind of mission, and turn a favorite setup into a one-click button.

chapters.title: House rules — instructions, settings and permissions
chapters.blurb: Tell every agent how you like things done, and decide what they may do without asking — without switching off the safety rails.

chapters.title: New abilities — skills, plugins, tools and hooks
chapters.blurb: Teach your agents new tricks: packaged skills, plugins, connected tools and automatic hooks — and how to add them safely.

chapters.title: Around the cockpit — Home, memory, usage, history and more
chapters.blurb: A guided walk through the rest of the app: dashboards, memory, usage meters, cost history, voice input and publishing.

chapters.title: Good habits — great results, safely
chapters.blurb: Ten habits that make your agents more helpful, cheaper and safer — and the common mistakes to avoid.

chapters.title: Glossary — every term in plain English
chapters.blurb: Every word this manual uses, explained in a sentence or two, with a pointer to where it is covered.
